title: Show live pp
description: Show the live pp of the play, updating as the map goes.

title: Show misses
description: Show the miss count.

title: Show 50s
description: Show the 50s hit count.

title: Show 100s
description: Show the 100s hit count.

title: Show 300s
description: Show the 300s hit count as well.

title: Show progress bar
description: Draw a thin bar under the chips that fills up as the map goes on.

title: Decimals
description: Digits after the decimal point of the pp value: 0 shows whole numbers.

title: Font family
description: CSS font family of the counter; a system fallback is added after it.

title: Font size (px)
description: Size of the pp number; the hit counts and the card paddings follow it.

title: Text color
description: Color of the pp number, and of every hit count when Colored hit counts is off.

title: Unit color
description: Color of the small unit next to the pp number.

title: Neon glow
description: Soft glow around the pp number.

title: Glow color
description: Color of the glow around the pp number.

title: Colored hit counts
description: Give every hit count its own color. Off: they all share a neutral chip.

title: 300s color
description: Color of the 300s chip.

title: 100s color
description: Color of the 100s chip.

title: 50s color
description: Color of the 50s chip.

title: Miss color
description: Color of the miss chip, and of the pp number while it flashes.

title: Progress color
description: Colour of the filled part of the progress bar.

title: Progress track
description: Colour of the empty track the progress bar runs on.

title: Card background
description: Translucent rounded panel behind the numbers. Off: the numbers stand alone.

title: Card color
description: Tint of the card behind the numbers.

title: Card opacity (%)
description: How solid the card is: 0 is invisible, 100 is opaque.

title: Card radius (px)
description: Roundness of the card corners.

title: Slide in from the left
description: Off: the counter enters from the right and leaves the same way. On: it enters from the left.

title: Slide duration (ms)
description: How long the entrance and the exit slide last; higher is slower.

title: Smooth live pp
description: Glide the pp number to a new value instead of jumping straight to it.

title: Smoothing (ms)
description: How long the number takes to reach a new value: 0 snaps to it immediately, higher is slower.

title: Flash on pp loss
description: Flash the pp number in the miss color for a moment when the live pp drops.

title: FC border
description: Tint the card border in the 300 color while the run has no misses and no slider breaks, and in the miss color once it has either.

title: Show only while playing
description: Off: the counter stays on screen everywhere. On: it only appears for a play, and on the results screen if that option is on.

title: Hide while paused
description: Take the counter off screen while the play is paused and bring it back on resume.

title: Keep on results screen
description: Keep the counter on screen after the map, with the final pp of the finished play.

title: Scale
description: Multiplies every size at once (font, paddings, radius, chips): 1 is normal size, 2 is twice as big.
